title: Non-HDL cholesterol

review.note: Drafted from the source below; not yet reviewed by a medical professional.

measures: Non-HDL cholesterol is the total cholesterol minus the HDL (good) cholesterol. It is reported as part of a cholesterol test, alongside total cholesterol, LDL, and HDL.
context: Non-HDL is measured as part of a cholesterol test, which may need fasting for 9 to 12 hours beforehand. In general, low LDL levels and high HDL levels are good for heart health, and a healthy level for a person can depend on age, family history, and other factors.
aboveRange: Eating foods high in saturated fat and cholesterol
Excess weight and a lack of physical activity
Smoking and drinking too much alcohol
Family history and genes, which cannot be changed
nextStep: Discuss this result with your doctor.
